title: Nuclear-transduction-ASD v1.0.0: code and derived data for 'How an under-pruned cortex rewrites its splicing code: Ca2+-tuned condensates outcompete transcription-speed and mechanical routes in idiopathic autism'
description: Reproducible pipeline (Python) confronting three biophysical channels by which an under-pruned, hyperactive cortex could alter neuronal splicing in idiopathic autism: Ca2+/condensate and energetic exhaustion (H-E), RNA Pol II elongation-rate kinetic coupling (H-K) and mechanical LINC transmission (H-M). Uses only public data (PsychENCODE cortex/cerebellum splicing and RNA-seq; Srrm4-KO, slow Pol II and KCl-neuron splicing tables; UCSC genome resources). Derived data and figures CC BY 4.0.
